The application to Judah by name, “Behold, I frame evil against you” (web:Jer.18.11), turns the same consonantal root into a verb rather than repeating the noun: הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י יוֹצֵ֤ר עֲלֵיכֶם֙ רָעָ֔ה (oshb:Jer.18.11, byte tier) is a bare participle, byte-distinct from the article-bearing noun that names the craftsman at 18:2, 18:3, 18:4 and 18:6 (sweep: 5 verses on the article-bearing form); the shared object is the consonantal root itself, which recurs at the wider, article-free search across the book (sweep: 10 verses on the bare root). That shared root, not a repeated token, binds the application and the people's own refusal, “It is in vain” (web:Jer.18.12), נוֹאָ֑שׁ (oshb:Jer.18.12, byte tier), to the observed sign. current_row.boundary_rationale: A fresh command opens the row: “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests” (web:Jer.19.1), spliced כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הָל֛וֹךְ וְקָנִ֥יתָ (oshb:Jer.19.1, byte tier) — the messenger formula followed by an infinitive absolute and a waw-prefixed second-person-singular suffix-conjugation form, not an imperative, opening on the prophet as addressee and distinct from the potter-house visit that precedes it and from the prophet’s own petition just before it, building a new commissioned sign on a jar rather than clay on a wheel. The command names the errand (buy the jar, go out to the valley of Ben-Hinnom, 19:1-2) and the oracle to proclaim there (19:3-9), then turns to the performance instruction, “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you” (web:Jer.19.10), before its own interpretation, כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶת הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁבֹּר֙ אֶת כְּלִ֣י הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר (oshb:Jer.19.11, byte tier) — “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel” (web:Jer.19.11) — closing on the Topheth-house judgment through 19:13. Command, performance instruction, and interpretation stay one unit because the same errand and the same named jar carry through from the buying to the breaking to the verdict on the houses of Jerusalem; the elders of the people and of the priests, וּמִזִּקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וּמִזִּקְנֵ֖י הַכֹּהֲנִֽים (oshb:Jer.19.1, byte tier), are named as taken along on the errand in the rendering, with no verb in the Hebrew governing that clause, and the witnesses at the breaking are instead הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַהֹלְכִ֖ים אוֹתָֽךְ (oshb:Jer.19.10, byte tier), the men who go with the prophet.
